comments.body: @fehiepsi do you have any tips on where to start looking? It is unclear to me where the fix is needed according to https://flax.readthedocs.io/en/latest/migrating/nnx_010_to_nnx_011.html#using-rngs-in-nnx-transforms . If I get a direction I can open a PR :)

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body:
I'm not sure if this line is the issue? https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/ab77747161bf0ccc817b743b76ec7ae7ba2f416c/test/contrib/test_module.py#L412

IIUC, we need to set `nnx.Rngs(params=0, dropout=1)`

comments.author: juanitorduz
comments.body:
> I'm not sure if this line is the issue?
> 
> [numpyro/test/contrib/test_module.py](https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/ab77747161bf0ccc817b743b76ec7ae7ba2f416c/test/contrib/test_module.py#L412)
> 
> Line 412 in [ab77747](/pyro-ppl/numpyro/commit/ab77747161bf0ccc817b743b76ec7ae7ba2f416c)
> 
>  net_module = Net(rngs=nnx.Rngs(params=rng_key)) 
> IIUC, we need to set `nnx.Rngs(params=0, dropout=1)`

Indeed! Thank you! https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/pull/2057
